job_title: Siemens Graduate Program 西门子管理培训生-产品专家方向
description_raw: Why Choose Us?    Founded in 1922, SGP (Siemens Graduate Program) is a time-honored Siemens trainee program for master graduates who want to change the future. SGP offers you the ideal start to your career – your opportunity to prepare yourself for a successful career at Siemens.  Designed as an intensive and internationally oriented two-year program, the SGP will prepare you for future leadership tasks, offering both flexibility and diverse work experiences. The program, which enables you to actively integrate your interests and your qualifications, consists of three to four challenging assignments. At least one of these assignments will take place abroad at one of our 1,700 international business locations. On this international rotation, you will learn about the local business and culture while taking on various responsibilities and project work.  These are highly appreciated by our current SGP participants include material and immaterial advantages. • Competitive compensation package • Tailored trainings • Given responsibility and own projects • International work that has a significant contribution • Be part of a global network • Assignment abroad You will also receive an intensive training program and the opportunity for personal development. A personal Development Manager will be at your side for the duration of the program, helping you to achieve your various objectives while promoting your development and assisting you in planning your career. What will you do if join us? • Strategic Insight: Monitor market demand trends and competitor iterations; conduct product competitiveness analysis; collaborate with Headquarters to optimize the product portfolio, ensuring clear strategic direction and prioritization. • Pricing Management: Establish a rational pricing architecture; execute annual price adjustments based on market dynamics to ensure pricing aligns with both market competition and corporate growth requirements. • Marketing & Promotion: Develop product promotion strategies; explore key product lines and new application scenarios; implement multi-channel promotions and create/update comprehensive sales toolkits to ensure product value is fully perceived by customers. • Lifecycle Support: Provide end-to-end support by tracking problem resolution, process implementation, resource management, and technical assistance; conduct systematic product training to offer professional backing for the entire product ecosystem from R&D to market launch. Who are we looking for?  • An above-average Master's, Diploma, Doctoral Degree or equivalent • Maximum of 2 years of working experience between/after bachelor and master graduation • Minimum of 4 months of international experience gained either through studying, working or living • Flexibility and mobility especially within the program duration  • Excellent command of English, business level proficiency in English, confident for cross border meetings, presentations and formal written communication. Other Requirements  • Basic knowledge of industrial automation; • Basic understanding of industrial control system architecture • Basic Programming skills and advanced Office skills • Good presentation skills • Major in AI, Electrical Engineering, Automatic Control, Control Science and Engineering, other science & engineering fields • Strong willingness for cross cultural interaction and high adaptability to international, multicultural working environments. • Quick learner with high agility, able to ramp up rapidly in new business fields Core Competence • Decision Making • Driving for Results • Influencing • Driving Innovation • Driving Change • Fostering Diversity • Information and Communication Technology Literacy • Agile way of working • Reflexivity What else to know? For more introduction on SGP, please visit our SGP website: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/jobs/search-careers/siemens-graduate-program.html #siemensgraduateprogram Do you think you have what it takes? We look forward to receiving your application!

description_raw: 项目概述 今天地球上生活着近80亿人，到本世纪末，这个数字将增至110亿。解决日益增长且越来越复杂的人口的需求，同时减轻对地球的影响，是西门子的核心工作。作为一家专注的科技公司，西门子智能基础设施集团（Smart Infrastructure, 简称SI）通过给客户提供更加智能的解决方案，融合现实世界和数字世界，为多行业减碳提供端到端的解决方案，引领低碳转型，为打造更低碳的智慧城市而助力. 西门子智能基础设施集团的“智 · 先锋”销售培训生项目（Smart Pioneer Sales Trainee Program），旨在通过系统化的高效培训和实践，将优秀的应届毕业生，培养成为具备数字化思维，能以智能化，数字化的的零碳解决方案，助力客户节能增效，推动产业低碳转型的销售人才。 该项目由SI资深培训导师倾情打造。在项目中，你不仅可以在不同岗位上轮岗实践，还可以接触到丰富的专业培训课程，并深入学习最前沿的数字化方案和零碳方案的架构，以及他们在不同场景下的应用。项目结束后，你将成为可以根据客户需求提供数字化、智能化解决方案的专家。 我能收获什么？ -专项系统培养：系统化培养，通过专业课程+轮岗实践，聚焦提升核心业务能力； -导师赋能成长：配备相应的成长导师，为你答疑解惑，分享经验，助力成长； -全方位的关怀：HR跟进你的成长路径，关注你的个人成长，为你排忧解难； -培训生专属社群：讨论工作，分享生活，建立更广人脉网络，成长路上不孤单； 加入SI团队，这里有： 一个前沿科技的职业，你可以掌握智能基础设施的技术革新与行业变革； 一个国际化的大平台，你可以敏锐洞察市场变化、捕捉世界行业风向； 一份充满意义的事业，你可以为智慧城市，低碳环保创造更多可能； 一群充满正能量的小伙伴，你可以在信任与授权中高效友爱地工作。  我的工作职责是什么？ 1. 经过专业的技术产品培训，具备成为产品方案全生命周期管理顾问的能力； 2. 了解客户需求，以数字化、智能化的解决方案帮助客户实现零碳目标； 3. 定期拜访客户，抓住业务机会，与客户建立良好有效的长期合作关系，收获业绩产出。                                                                               我如何才能胜任？ 1. 2027届即将毕业的本科生或研究生，理工科相关专业; 2. 有销售相关实习或实践经验优先考虑; 3. 英语听、说、读、写熟练； 4. 富有开拓精神，敢于不断挑战自我； 5. 热爱学习，具备引领变革的潜力； 6. 乐于沟通，具备出色的沟通技巧； 7. 善于合作，具备良好的团队意识； 8. 具有清晰的逻辑思维，善于发现和解决问题； 我还需要知道什么？ 西门子作为一家专注的科技公司，创立于1847年，业务遍及全球200个国家。自1872年进入中国，一直以创新的技术、卓越的解决方案和产品，坚持不懈地对中国的发展提供全面支持。西门子智能基础设施集团赋能客户实现高效减排，以及全价值链的数字化。目前已在全国为超过3500家客户，提供高效智能的解决方案。 一百多年的历史，沉淀下的不仅有完善的管理流程，成熟的人才培养机制，而且有对产品的不断创新以及对未来的不断探索。快来加入我们，用你的智慧和潜力和我们一起挑战未来吧！
